case_for: Founder is strong at brand and creative; real order volume after 18 months (S3, R4).
case_against: Repeat rate not tracked - the brand's defining risk is unowned (R1, R3).
Two thirds of orders from paid social with rising CAC - growth is bought (R3, R5).
Solo founder with no P&L or supply-chain experience, unaware of the gap (S3).
Crowded category, single contract manufacturer (S4, R4, R6).
call_questions: What share of customers from three months ago have bought again? If you don't know, how would you find out this week?
What is CAC by channel this month vs six months ago, and gross margin after returns?
What happens if your contract manufacturer fails a batch or raises prices?
Who will own operations, supply chain and the P&L?
We think you're a strong marketer but not yet a business builder - what would you say to that?
what_would_change_our_view: Cohort repeat data showing customers return without paid re-acquisition, falling dependence on paid social, and a co-founder or hire who owns operations and the P&L.
